contaminationNote: Untouched V1.9 holdout. Only sources public by 2017-03-31 are frozen before company mapping or post-cutoff outcome reveal.

lanes.limitations: Selected central-government NEV policy records; not exhaustive.
Selected People's Daily/China Securities Journal/First Financial/Daily Economic News.
No clean point-in-time community archive was available.

sourceItems.title: 新能源车补贴又有新变化
normalizedClaims: The revised NEV subsidy policy took effect on 2017-01-01.
Subsidy amounts stepped down by about 20% and technical thresholds for energy use, range, battery performance and safety were tightened.
The policy ended a broad universal-subsidy approach and increased technology/quality differentiation across vehicles and batteries.
observedChanges: a new policy regime reduces aggregate subsidy while increasing technical-quality thresholds

sourceItems.title: 1月份新能源汽车产销量断崖式下跌
normalizedClaims: January NEV production and sales fell about 69.1% and 74.4% YoY.
The report linked the abrupt decline to the subsidy reset and re-approval of recommended models.
The aggregate demand shock was especially severe in electric buses.
observedChanges: new policy causes a severe near-term aggregate demand air pocket

sourceItems.title: 2月新能源车销量反弹 进入稳定增长阶段
normalizedClaims: February NEV sales recovered to about 18,000 units, +145% MoM and +30.3% YoY.
Jan-Feb cumulative production and sales were still down roughly one-third YoY.
The first 2017 recommended-model catalog was released on January 23, allowing some normalization after the policy/catalog air pocket.
observedChanges: aggregate demand begins to normalize but remains below prior-year cumulative volume

sourceItems.title: 现货紧缺 MDI易涨难跌
normalizedClaims: From late February, pure MDI rose about 10.86% and polymeric MDI about 8.33%.
March list prices from major suppliers clustered around RMB25,500-26,000/t while spot offers could be substantially higher.
The immediate driver was sustained tight physical supply and low spot availability.
observedChanges: a fresh late-quarter spot-supply shortage creates incremental MDI pricing pressure

sourceItems.title: CMI指数提示旺季来临，预计2月挖掘机销量增幅超六成
sourceItems.publisher: 三一集团官网行业资讯
normalizedClaims: January domestic excavator sales were up about 57.9% YoY.
The source explicitly said excavator growth had remained high since September 2016.
The rebound was linked to mining, rural, municipal, railway and highway demand as well as a low prior-year base.
observedChanges: construction-machinery recovery continues from a pre-existing 2016H2 rebound

sourceItems.title: 挖掘机销量创新高 工程机械行业持续复苏
sourceItems.publisher: 每日经济新闻转载中证信息
normalizedClaims: Jan-Feb excavator sales were about 19,077 units, +188.9% YoY.
February sales were about 14,540 units, +298% YoY, a record monthly growth rate.
Infrastructure/PPP and replacement demand were cited as important supports.
observedChanges: the existing machinery recovery accelerates dramatically but remains a continuation signal

sourceItems.title: DRAM Price Will Achieve Record Increase for Off-Peak Season in First Quarter of 2017
normalizedClaims: DRAM price upswing began in the second half of 2016 and was expected to persist through Q1 2017.
PC and server DRAM contract prices were expected to rise roughly 30% QoQ in Q1.
The signal was strong but explicitly a continuation of a pre-existing H2 2016 supply cycle.
observedChanges: global DRAM tightness continues rather than begins in Q1

sourceItems.title: Tight Supply Causes Contract Prices of Server DRAM Modules to Rise Over 25% Sequentially in First Quarter of 2017
normalizedClaims: Server DRAM module contract prices had already risen more than 25% sequentially at the start of Q1.
High-density modules saw increases near 30%, confirming severe tightness.
observedChanges: downstream contract pricing strongly confirms the continuing DRAM supply shortage

sourceItems.title: Global DRAM Revenue Jumped 18.2% Sequentially in Fourth Quarter of 2016
normalizedClaims: Global DRAM revenue had already risen 18.2% QoQ in Q4 2016.
PC DRAM contract prices had risen more than 30% in Q4 and server DRAM was expected to catch up in Q1.
The product-market earnings state was already strongly realized before the Q1 cutoff.
observedChanges: supplier revenue already reflects much of the continuing global DRAM tightness

sourceItems.title: 钛白粉今年每吨涨了2000元企业还要提价
normalizedClaims: By February 16 titanium-dioxide prices had risen from about RMB14,913/t at year start to about RMB16,940/t, roughly +13.6%.
Listed and private producers were continuing to raise prices.
Supply-demand imbalance, environmental pressure and exports were cited as supports.

sourceItems.title: 龙蟒佰利：钛白粉价格再度上调1000元/吨
normalizedClaims: Longmang Baili raised TiO2 prices another RMB1,000/t domestically and US$100/t internationally.
This was already the company's fourth announced price increase in 2017.
The underlying industry had also experienced repeated increases during 2016, so Q1 is continuation rather than a first-time shock.
observedChanges: repeated company price hikes reinforce an already-established TiO2 cycle

sourceItems.title: 钴价暴涨背后：炒钴还是炒股
normalizedClaims: Cobalt prices had risen more than 125% over roughly one year.
Related A-share concept stocks had also risen sharply; Huayou Cobalt was reported up nearly threefold over roughly a year.
A widely circulated hoarding rumor was denied, while market participants raised concerns about commodity/equity speculation.
observedChanges: a real cobalt cycle is accompanied by extreme price/equity absorption and speculative narratives

sourceItems.title: 有色化工涨价此起彼伏 A股轮番炒作周期表行情
normalizedClaims: Cobalt had already started a large rally around October 2016 and was up roughly 80% over four months.
The broader market was actively trading price-increase/cyclical themes.
This makes Q1 cobalt an explicit continuation/high-absorption case rather than a fresh unrecognized driver.
observedChanges: cobalt's fundamental cycle and market narrative are already mature by early March

eventClusters.statement: A new 2017 NEV subsidy/catalog regime sharply reduced January demand but simultaneously raised technical thresholds, followed by a partial February normalization.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Aggregate demand was damaged, but tighter technical thresholds can redistribute share toward qualified products. Do not average those two paths together.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any listed company have a cutoff-valid technology/quality exception whose earnings path improves under the new thresholds despite the aggregate demand reset?

eventClusters.statement: MDI experienced a fresh late-February/early-March spot shortage and renewed price acceleration on top of an already-improved 2016 baseline.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: MDI had already risen in 2016, so the company case must prove that the late-Q1 shortage changes the frozen earnings path rather than merely repeating the old story.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is the late-Q1 supply shortage a source-linked incremental earnings reset for a direct producer after measuring the pre-event baseline and price absorption?

eventClusters.statement: Excavator sales accelerated to record growth in February, but the recovery had already been running at high growth since September 2016.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Record February growth is powerful confirmation but not a new thesis. V1.9 must not relabel it as fresh merely because the data point is spectacular.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can machinery pass an inherited V1.8/V1.5 route on its own, without using the V1.9 fresh relaxation?

eventClusters.statement: Global DRAM prices and supplier revenue continued a supply-driven upcycle that had already begun in 2016H2.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Product economics are strongly confirmed but the cycle predates Q1. Direct current A-share supplier earnings are still required; proxy substitution remains prohibited.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a direct current A-share DRAM earnings expression, and if not should the signal remain No selection despite the strong global cycle?

eventClusters.statement: Titanium-dioxide producers repeatedly raised prices through Q1, extending an industry upcycle that had already produced many hikes in 2016.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The price cycle is real but repeated. Strong company earnings may still justify an inherited route, but V1.9 fresh escalation is forbidden.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: After multiple prior price hikes, is there residual expectation/valuation room under inherited rules, or is this a continuation trade?

eventClusters.statement: Cobalt's supply/demand cycle remained strong, but by early March both the commodity and obvious A-share proxies had already rerated dramatically and speculative narratives were widespread.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A true commodity bull market can still be a bad incremental equity entry after extreme product/equity absorption. Rumors must not substitute for supply-demand evidence.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any direct producer retain measurable earnings/valuation asymmetry under inherited rules, without using V1.9 fresh escalation?
